incorrectReviewNotes.2: AWS Lambda has a hard maximum execution timeout of 15 minutes, making it impossible to run scripts that take up to 30 minutes without major refactoring.
incorrectReviewNotes.4: AWS Transfer Family is a fully managed service that allows legacy SFTP clients to upload files directly into Amazon S3 buckets without managing EC2 SFTP servers.
incorrectReviewNotes.5: Amazon Aurora Global Database is MySQL-compatible (preserving the relational schema) and replicates data across multiple AWS Regions with sub-second latency, enabling fast local reads for global branch offices.
incorrectReviewNotes.10: Amazon FSx for Windows File Server is built on Windows Server, supports the SMB protocol, integrates with Microsoft Active Directory, and supports Multi-AZ Microsoft Distributed File System (DFS) namespaces and replication.
incorrectReviewNotes.14: Application Load Balancer (ALB) has native built-in support for authenticating users via Amazon Cognito User Pools (or OIDC) using listener rules, requiring zero custom code.
incorrectReviewNotes.16: You cannot encrypt an existing unencrypted Amazon RDS database in-place, and an unencrypted primary DB cannot have an encrypted Multi-AZ standby or encrypted read replica.
incorrectReviewNotes.21: Because EBS volumes are local to individual EC2 instances, videos uploaded by a user are scattered across different servers.
incorrectReviewNotes.23: The aws:RequestedRegion global condition key compares the target AWS Region of the API request (the Region where the resource is being created/acted upon) with the Region specified in the policy.
incorrectReviewNotes.25: Just like in Question 12, aws:SourceIp refers to the caller's (user's) source IP address, not the IP address of the EC2 instance.
incorrectReviewNotes.29: EC2 User Data scripts run only once during the initial launch boot cycle by default, and they always execute as the root user by default (you do not need sudo in user data scripts).
incorrectReviewNotes.33:
Compute: Because the app is already Kubernetes-based, Amazon EKS with AWS Fargate lets the company migrate its Kubernetes manifests directly without managing EC2 worker nodes.
Messaging: Amazon SQS does not support industry-standard protocols like AMQP, MQTT, or JMS (it uses its own proprietary AWS API).
incorrectReviewNotes.35:
Two key points here:
Certificates created via ACM are renewed automatically by ACM; only imported third-party certificates require manual renewal monitoring.
AWS Config provides an off-the-shelf managed rule (acm-certificate-expiration-check) that evaluates imported ACM certificates against a specified number of days (e.g., 30 days) and can directly notify the team via Amazon SNS with minimal setup.
incorrectReviewNotes.36: AWS WAF is a Layer 7 web application firewall. It can only be attached to an Application Load Balancer (ALB), Amazon CloudFront, Amazon API Gateway, AWS AppSync, Amazon Cognito User Pools, or AWS App Runner.
incorrectReviewNotes.38: While Amazon EFS is the right service for shared file storage concurrently mounted by hundreds of EC2 instances, the question specifically asks to store less frequently accessed files in the most cost-effective way.
incorrectReviewNotes.41: Amazon Comprehend is AWS's fully managed Natural Language Processing (NLP) service that extracts sentiment (emotional tone: positive, negative, neutral, mixed), key phrases, entities, and topics from text.
incorrectReviewNotes.42: When a workload can run across multiple servers of various sizes with a variable number of CPUs and must withstand server failures, a Spot Fleet is superior to standalone Spot Instances.
incorrectReviewNotes.43:
An ELB is a single-Region resource and cannot distribute traffic across a global (multi-Region) application.
Route 53 weighted routing relies on DNS, which is hindered by mobile clients caching DNS records for long periods.
AWS Global Accelerator provides static Anycast IPs and uses traffic dials and endpoint weights to shift traffic across global endpoints within seconds, completely bypassing client-side DNS caching.
incorrectReviewNotes.45: Storing static AWS credentials on an EC2 instance (whether in plain text, CLI config, or custom-encrypted files) is a major security anti-pattern.
incorrectReviewNotes.46: To encrypt and decrypt data using the same KMS key across two AWS Regions, you must use an AWS KMS Multi-Region Key.
incorrectReviewNotes.54:
Security Group A (Web Servers): Accepts HTTPS requests from users on port 443 (inbound from 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443) and initiates database queries to the MSSQL servers in Security Group B on port 1433 (outbound to SG B on port 1433, not 443).
Security Group B (MSSQL Database): Should follow least privilege by allowing inbound traffic on port 1433 only from Security Group A (not from all sources).
incorrectReviewNotes.55: When a backend EC2 application is overwhelmed by traffic surges and dropping messages, the standard pattern to decouple and buffer requests with minimal operational overhead is Amazon SQS.
incorrectReviewNotes.56: Video conferencing and Network Load Balancers (NLBs) operate at Layer 4 (TCP/UDP). Amazon CloudFront is a Layer 7 CDN that only supports HTTP/HTTPS traffic and cannot accelerate UDP/non-HTTP TCP connections.
incorrectReviewNotes.58: Raw Zone: Data in the raw zone is processed once by the daily Glue ETL job and then only kept for 5 years to meet compliance rules.
incorrectReviewNotes.60: To use an Amazon Route 53 Private Hosted Zone with a VPC, two VPC attributes must be enabled (true): enableDnsHostnames (DNS hostnames) and enableDnsSupport (DNS resolution).
incorrectReviewNotes.61: Just like in Question 10, whenever a cloud-based workload requires shared file storage over the SMB (Server Message Block) protocol with minimal administrative overhead, Amazon FSx for Windows File Server is the native, fully managed AWS service.
incorrectReviewNotes.65: For a standard Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB instance deployment (primary + 1 standby), database engine version upgrades upgrade both the primary and standby DB instances at the same time, which causes downtime until the upgrade completes.
